newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan's CPC buys 7,000 tns of Oct MTBE at $280/tn.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's CPC buys 7,000 tns of Oct MTBE at $280/tn.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought through a tender 7,000 tonnes of methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) for October 1-15 delivery at $280 per tonne, a CPC official said on Wednesday.
The official said CPC bought two cargoes of 3,500 tonnes each because of expectations petrochemical giant Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC) was planning an unscheduled shutdown of a plant.
"We think the price will go up," the official said. "It is the right time to take two cargoes."
